title: House climate
description: Each room's temperature and humidity over days, what the thermostat and mini splits are doing, and what the metered plugs use. Source: Home Assistant (job="homeassistant"). A room reads its *_climate_sensor (the living room its Nest thermostat), joined to the room's area and floor; legends name areas by id. The utility meter's Green Button statistics are not exported to Prometheus, so whole-house energy is not here.

targets.expr: max by (area) (homeassistant_sensor_temperature_celsius{entity=~"sensor[.].+_(climate_sensor|nest_thermostat)_temperature"} * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info * on (area) group_left (floor) homeassistant_area_info{floor="main_floor"}) * 9 / 5 + 32

max by (area) (homeassistant_sensor_temperature_celsius{entity=~"sensor[.].+_(climate_sensor|nest_thermostat)_temperature"} * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info * on (area) group_left (floor) homeassistant_area_info{floor="basement"}) * 9 / 5 + 32

panels.title: outdoor °F
panels.description: The mini split condensers' outdoor thermistors; the coolest reads closest to the air.

targets.expr: max by (area) (homeassistant_sensor_humidity_percent{entity=~"sensor[.].+_(climate_sensor|nest_thermostat)_humidity"} * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info * on (area) group_left (floor) homeassistant_area_info{floor="main_floor"})

max by (area) (homeassistant_sensor_humidity_percent{entity=~"sensor[.].+_(climate_sensor|nest_thermostat)_humidity"} * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info * on (area) group_left (floor) homeassistant_area_info{floor="basement"})

panels.title: HVAC running, share of each hour

targets.expr: max by (area, action) (avg_over_time(homeassistant_climate_action{action=~"heating|cooling"}[1h]) * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info) > 0
max by (area, mode) (avg_over_time(homeassistant_climate_mode{mode!="off"}[1h]) unless on (entity) homeassistant_climate_action * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info) > 0

panels.description: The thermostat reports whether it is heating or cooling; the mini splits report only their mode, so theirs is the share of the hour they were switched on.

panels.title: setpoints °F

targets.expr: max by (area) ((homeassistant_climate_target_temperature_low_celsius * 9 / 5 + 32) * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info unless on (entity) homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="off"} == 1)

max by (area) ((homeassistant_climate_target_temperature_high_celsius * 9 / 5 + 32) * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info unless on (entity) homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="off"} == 1)

max by (area) ((homeassistant_climate_target_temperature_celsius * 9 / 5 + 32) * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info unless on (entity) homeassistant_climate_mode{mode="off"} == 1)

panels.description: Only while the unit is not off.

targets.expr: max by (area, plug) (label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time(homeassistant_sensor_power_w{entity=~"sensor[.].+_plug_power"}[1h]), "plug", "$2", "entity", "sensor[.](.*_)?([a-z]+)_plug_power"), "plug", "plug", "plug", "room") * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info)

panels.title: plug energy kWh, last 7 days

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (area, plug) (label_replace(label_replace((max_over_time(homeassistant_sensor_energy_kwh{entity=~"sensor[.].+_plug_summation_delivered"}[7d]) - min_over_time(homeassistant_sensor_energy_kwh{entity=~"sensor[.].+_plug_summation_delivered"}[7d])), "plug", "$2", "entity", "sensor[.](.*_)?([a-z]+)_plug_summation_delivered"), "plug", "plug", "plug", "room") * on (entity) group_left (area) homeassistant_entity_info))

panels.description: The meter's rise over the window: the plugs' readings dip now and then, which increase() would count as resets.
